items.title: Biological effects of technique-specific manual therapy in healthy individuals and people with musculoskeletal disorders: a systematic review with meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 50 studies (n=2,147) found that manual therapy induces short-term neurophysiological modulation with technique-specific responses: joint mobilization increases sympathetic markers, while soft tissue techniques increase parasympathetic markers, suggesting MT interacts with regulatory systems in a technique-dependent manner.
items.curatedReason: 这项高质量系统综述首次区分了不同手法治疗（MT）技术对神经生理和代谢的生物学效应。它告诉你，关节松动术主要引起交感神经反应，而软组织技术则与副交感神经活动增加相关。这意味着 MT 的生物学机制是技术特异性的，别再把所有手法混为一谈了。
items.titleZh: 技术特异性手法治疗在健康个体和肌肉骨骼疾病患者中的生物学效应：一项系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 50 项研究（n=2,147）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，手法治疗（MT）通过技术特异性反应引起短期神经生理调节：关节松动术增加交感神经标记，而软组织技术增加副交感神经标记，表明 MT 以技术依赖性方式与调节系统相互作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This high-quality systematic review is the first to differentiate the biological effects of various manual therapy (MT) techniques on neurophysiological and metabolic responses. It indicates that joint mobilization primarily elicits sympathetic responses, while soft tissue techniques are associated with increased parasympathetic activity. This means the biological mechanisms of MT are technique-specific; avoid lumping all manual therapies together.
items.limitation: 研究纳入的证据质量为低到中等，且存在方法学异质性和不精确性，限制了强力推论。
items.limitationEn: The included evidence had low to moderate certainty, with methodological heterogeneity and imprecision limiting strong conclusions.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: Developing biopsychosocial competence in musculoskeletal pain care: Australian physiotherapy educators' perspectives.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored the perspectives of 18 experienced physiotherapy pain educators in Australia, identifying five themes, termed "levers to biopsychosocial translation," that support competence and clinical adoption in musculoskeletal pain care.
items.curatedReason: 本研究通过澳洲理疗教育者的视角，提供了在肌骨疼痛护理中提升生物心理社会能力的具体"翻译杠杆"（教学、课程、临床支持策略），这有助于你更好地将该模型融入教学与临床实践。
items.titleZh: 发展肌骨疼痛护理中的生物心理社会能力：澳大利亚物理治疗教育者的视角
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了澳大利亚 18 位资深物理治疗疼痛教育者的视角，识别了五个主题（"生物心理社会翻译杠杆"），这些主题支持肌骨疼痛护理中生物心理社会能力的提升和临床采纳。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study, through the lens of Australian physiotherapy educators, provides concrete "translation levers" (teaching, curriculum, and clinical support strategies) to enhance biopsychosocial competence in musculoskeletal pain care. This can help you better integrate the model into your teaching and clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，结果基于访谈数据，可能存在主观性和地域局限性，其发现的"翻译杠杆"需进一步的定量验证。
items.limitationEn: As a qualitative study based on interview data, findings may have subjectivity and regional limitations; the identified "translation levers" require further quantitative validation.

items.title: Comparison of action observation therapy and virtual reality combined with conventional therapy for upper extremity rehabilitation in children with unilateral cerebral palsy.
items.summary: An RCT with 45 children with unilateral cerebral palsy found that both action observation therapy (AOT) and XBOX 360 Kinect, when combined with conventional physiotherapy, significantly improved upper extremity function, activity, and quality of life compared to conventional therapy alone, with AOT showing broader gains.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 发现，对于单侧脑瘫儿童的上肢康复，动作观察疗法（AOT）和虚拟现实（XBOX Kinect）结合传统疗法，效果均优于单纯传统疗法，其中 AOT 带来了更广泛的获益。在制定儿童脑瘫康复方案时，考虑将这些辅助疗法纳入你的工具箱。
items.titleZh: 动作观察疗法和虚拟现实结合传统疗法在单侧脑瘫儿童上肢康复中的比较研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 45 名单侧脑瘫儿童的随机对照试验发现，动作观察疗法（AOT）和 XBOX 360 Kinect 结合传统物理治疗后，在上肢功能、活动和生活质量方面均显著优于单独传统疗法，其中 AOT 带来了更广泛的改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found that for upper extremity rehabilitation in children with unilateral cerebral palsy, both action observation therapy (AOT) and virtual reality (XBOX Kinect) combined with conventional therapy were superior to conventional therapy alone, with AOT showing broader benefits. Consider incorporating these adjunct therapies into your toolkit when designing rehabilitation programs for children with cerebral palsy.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小（45 名儿童），随访期短（3 周），可能无法完全捕捉长期效果，且 XBOX Kinect 作为特定平台，其结果外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: The study had a relatively small sample size (45 children) and a short follow-up period (3 weeks), which may not fully capture long-term effects, and results for a specific platform like XBOX Kinect may have limited generalizability.

items.title: Proprioception Training and Surrogate Outcomes: A Systematic Review of Definitions, Measures, and Effectiveness Claims.
items.summary: A systematic review of 51 randomized controlled trials (n=2,319) found that improvements inferred from surrogate outcomes (balance, strength, pain) were more frequent than those in direct psychophysical proprioceptive measures. Specific, attentionally demanding training aligned with measured submodalities yielded the most consistent benefits in position-reproduction accuracy, movement-detection, or discrimination.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述明确指出，"本体感觉训练"的有效性往往被替代性结局（如平衡、力量、疼痛）夸大，而直接针对特定感觉结构（如关节位置觉）的训练才能真正改善本体感觉。它提醒你在设计训练和评估时，要区分真正的本体感觉改善与一般的运动适应。
items.titleZh: 本体感觉训练与替代结局：定义、测量和有效性主张的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 51 项随机对照试验（n=2,319）的系统综述发现，从替代性结局（平衡、力量、疼痛）推断的改善比直接心理物理本体感觉测量的改善更常见。与测量子模态一致的、特定的、需要注意力的训练在位置再现准确性、运动检测或辨别方面产生了最一致的益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review clearly states that the effectiveness of "proprioception training" is often overstated by surrogate outcomes (e.g., balance, strength, pain), and only training directly targeting specific sensory constructs (e.g., joint position sense) genuinely improves proprioception. It reminds you to distinguish true proprioceptive improvement from general motor adaptation when designing training and assessment.
items.limitation: 研究纳入的试验存在方法学质量和偏倚风险，且各研究对本体感觉的定义和测量方法差异较大，限制了结果的综合性。
items.limitationEn: The included trials had methodological quality and bias risks, and the definitions and measures of proprioception varied across studies, limiting synthesis.

items.title: Effects of a Cycling-Based Aerobic Exercise Program Versus a Resistance and Neuromuscular Exercise Program on Exercise-Induced Hypoalgesia in Knee Osteoarthritis: A Study Protocol for a Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.summary: This study protocol describes a randomized, controlled, single-blind trial comparing a cycling-based aerobic exercise program with a resistance and neuromuscular exercise program on exercise-induced hypoalgesia in 90 participants with knee osteoarthritis over 10 weeks.
items.curatedReason: 这份研究方案预告，我们将有机会了解骑行有氧运动与抗阻/神经肌肉训练，哪种能在膝骨关节炎（KOA）患者中更好地诱导运动性镇痛。这项为期10周、涉及90名受试者的RCT，有望直接指导你为KOA患者选择最有效的运动镇痛方案。
items.titleZh: 循环式有氧运动与抗阻及神经肌肉运动对膝骨关节炎运动诱导镇痛影响的比较：一项随机临床试验的研究方案
items.summaryZh: 本研究方案描述了一项随机、对照、单盲试验，旨在比较骑行有氧运动项目与抗阻及神经肌肉运动项目对 90 名膝骨关节炎患者运动诱导镇痛（EIH）的影响，为期 10 周。
items.curatedReasonEn: This protocol suggests we'll soon have direct evidence on whether cycling-based aerobic exercise or resistance/neuromuscular training is superior for exercise-induced hypoalgesia (EIH) in knee osteoarthritis (KOA) patients. This 10-week, 90-participant RCT should directly inform your exercise prescription choices for EIH in KOA.
items.limitation: 这是一项研究方案，尚未提供任何临床结果或有效性数据。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol and does not yet provide any clinical results or efficacy data.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Vestibular rehabilitation therapy in Turkey: insights into physical therapists' clinical practice.
items.summary: A survey of 178 licensed physical therapists in Turkey revealed significant gaps in their knowledge, beliefs, and clinical practices regarding vestibular rehabilitation therapy (VRT), with 88.8% having no VRT experience and over 60% unfamiliar with key techniques.
items.curatedReason: 这项土耳其调研揭示了当地物理治疗师在前庭康复治疗（VRT）知识和实践方面的显著差距。如果你在美国或澳洲执业，这篇研究的直接参考意义不大，但侧面提醒你在评估自己国家 VRT 培训和实践时，可能也有类似机会。
items.titleZh: 土耳其的前庭康复治疗：物理治疗师临床实践洞察
items.summaryZh: 一项针对土耳其 178 名执业物理治疗师的调查显示，他们在前庭康复治疗（VRT）的知识、信念和临床实践方面存在显著差距，其中 88.8% 的人没有 VRT 经验，超过 60% 的人不熟悉关键技术。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Turkish survey reveals significant gaps in physical therapists' knowledge and practice of vestibular rehabilitation therapy (VRT) in the region. While its direct relevance to US or Australian practice may be limited, it serves as a reminder to assess similar opportunities in VRT training and practice within your own country.
items.limitation: 本研究是针对土耳其物理治疗师的横断面调查，结果存在地域局限性，且无法推断因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional survey of Turkish physical therapists, with regionally specific results and no causal inferences.

items.title: Effects of High-Intensity Laser Therapy on Functional Outcomes and Spasticity-Related Pain in Subacute and Chronic Stroke Patients with Plantar Flexor Spasticity: A Randomized Sham-Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized sham-controlled trial (n=24) investigated high-intensity laser therapy (HILT) for plantar flexor spasticity in subacute and chronic stroke patients, finding significant reductions in spasticity-related pain and a small covariate-adjusted gait speed benefit, but no change in spasticity or muscle thickness.
items.curatedReason: 高强度激光疗法（HILT）作为卒中后足底屈肌痉挛的辅助治疗，在本初步试验中显示出减轻痉挛相关疼痛的潜力，并可能对步态速度有小幅改善。但在广泛推荐之前，需等待更大样本量、更有力的研究确认其临床效用。
items.titleZh: 高强度激光疗法对亚急性期和慢性期卒中患者足底屈肌痉挛的功能结局和痉挛相关疼痛的影响：一项随机假对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机假对照试验（n=24）评估了高强度激光疗法（HILT）对亚急性期和慢性期卒中患者足底屈肌痉挛的疗效。研究发现 HILT 能显著减轻痉挛相关疼痛，并伴有小幅、经协变量调整后的步态速度改善，但对痉挛或肌肉厚度无影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: High-intensity laser therapy (HILT) shows potential for reducing spasticity-related pain and possibly a small gait speed benefit as an adjunct for plantar flexor spasticity in stroke patients, as indicated by this preliminary trial. However, larger, more robust studies are needed to confirm its clinical utility before widespread recommendation.
items.limitation: 本研究为初步试验，样本量小（24 人），激光对步态速度的益处在临床意义上仍不确定，且未观察到痉挛或肌肉厚度的改善。
items.limitationEn: This was a preliminary trial with a small sample size (n=24), the clinical significance of the gait speed benefit is uncertain, and no improvements in spasticity or muscle thickness were observed.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: The Added Value of Neural Mobilization Techniques to Proprioceptive Neuromuscular Facilitation in Patients With Adhesive Capsulitis: Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=56) found that combining neural mobilization techniques (NMTs) with proprioceptive neuromuscular facilitation (PNF) and conventional physical therapy for adhesive capsulitis resulted in statistically significant short-term improvements in pain, disability, and passive shoulder ROM, with a 14.08° increase in abduction, but pain and disability changes did not reach MCID thresholds.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提示，对于肩周炎，神经松动术结合 PNF 和常规物理治疗，短期内能带来统计学显著的肩关节活动度（外展增加 14.08°）改善，但疼痛和功能障碍的临床意义不明显。在纳入常规方案前，仍需更多研究验证其长期临床效益。
items.titleZh: 神经松动术结合本体感受神经肌肉促进技术对肩周炎患者的附加价值：随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=56）显示，神经松动术结合本体感受神经肌肉促进技术及常规物理治疗，能显著改善肩周炎患者的疼痛、功能障碍和肩关节被动活动度，肩外展增加 14.08°，但疼痛和功能障碍的改善未达临床最小重要差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that for adhesive capsulitis, combining neural mobilization techniques with PNF and conventional physical therapy can lead to statistically significant short-term improvements in shoulder ROM (abduction increased by 14.08°), but clinically meaningful benefits for pain and disability are not clear. Further research is needed to validate long-term clinical efficacy before incorporating it into routine protocols.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（56 人），随访期短（6 周），且疼痛和功能障碍的改善未达到临床最小重要差异（MCID），表明实际临床效益有限。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (n=56) and a short follow-up period (6 weeks); improvements in pain and disability did not meet the MCID, indicating limited practical clinical benefit.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Effect of Sequential Electroacupuncture Combined With Augmented Reality Gait Training on Walking Function and Neuromuscular Control in Subacute Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A single-blind RCT (n=40) in subacute stroke patients found that sequential electroacupuncture combined with augmented reality gait training significantly improved gait speed (Wald χ²=6.509, P=0.011), stride length, gait symmetry, motor function, and balance compared to AR alone after 4 weeks.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT有力支持了在亚急性卒中患者步态训练中，顺序电针结合AR训练的增效作用。电针预处理能显著提高步速、步长、步态对称性和平衡功能。建议您在临床实践中考虑这种联合干预方案，尤其是针对步态功能恢复。
items.titleZh: 顺序电针结合增强现实步态训练对亚急性卒中患者步行功能和神经肌肉控制的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对40名亚急性卒中患者的单盲随机对照试验显示，顺序电针结合增强现实步态训练在4周后显著改善了步速（Wald χ²=6.509, P=0.011）、步长、步态对称性、运动功能和平衡，优于单独AR训练。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT strongly supports the additive effect of sequential electroacupuncture combined with AR gait training in subacute stroke patients. Electroacupuncture pre-treatment significantly improves gait speed, stride length, gait symmetry, and balance. Consider this combined intervention in your clinical practice, especially for gait function recovery.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小（n=40），且随访期较短，长期效果和机制需进一步研究证实。
items.limitationEn: The study's relatively small sample size (n=40) and short follow-up period mean long-term effects and mechanisms require further confirmation.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: When evidence fails in real life: Rethinking sports injury rehabilitation and prevention.
items.summary: This commentary critically examines traditional, reductionist models in sports injury prevention and rehabilitation, advocating for an integrated, complexity-informed framework. It redefines evidence-based practice and the biopsychosocial model to support patient-centered and contextually relevant physical therapy.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评提醒我们，运动损伤的康复和预防不能简单地依赖线性和还原论框架。它强调了将复杂性科学、整合的循证实践以及动态的生物心理社会模型融入临床实践的重要性，以实现更个性化、背景敏感的治疗方案。
items.titleZh: 当证据在现实生活中失效时：重新思考运动损伤康复与预防
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评批判性审视了运动损伤预防与康复中的传统还原论模型，提倡整合复杂性科学、循证实践和动态生物心理社会模型，以支持以患者为中心、与情境相关的物理治疗。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary reminds us that sports injury rehabilitation and prevention cannot solely rely on linear, reductionist frameworks. It emphasizes the importance of integrating complexity science, a holistic view of evidence-based practice, and a dynamic biopsychosocial model into clinical practice for more personalized, context-sensitive treatment approaches.

items.title: Physical dependence, self-efficacy, and resilience in stroke patients: a double-moderated mediation model of healthcare group and pre-stroke employment.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study (n=123) found that greater physical dependence in stroke patients is concurrently associated with lower resilience, a relationship partially mediated by lower self-efficacy. This conditional indirect pathway was particularly pronounced in the routine care group among patients unemployed prior to stroke onset.
items.curatedReason: 本横断面研究提示，卒中患者的躯体依赖程度与复原力负相关，这种关系部分由自我效能介导。对接受常规护理且卒中前失业的患者，这一负相关尤为明显。应将患者的就业史和社会角色纳入康复策略，以支持其心理社会适应。
items.titleZh: 卒中患者的躯体依赖、自我效能和复原力：医疗组与卒中前就业的双重调节中介模型
items.summaryZh: 一项对123名卒中患者的横断面研究显示，躯体依赖程度与复原力负相关，其中自我效能发挥部分中介作用。尤其在接受常规护理且卒中前失业的患者中，这种条件性间接路径更为显著。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional study suggests that physical dependence is negatively associated with resilience in stroke patients, partially mediated by self-efficacy. This negative correlation is particularly pronounced in patients receiving routine care who were unemployed pre-stroke. Incorporate patients' employment history and social roles into rehabilitation strategies to support their psychosocial adaptation.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法建立因果关系，且样本量较小（n=123），结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study cannot establish causality and its small sample size (n=123) limits generalizability.

items.title: Quantitative evaluation of shoulder motor compensation in stroke patients based on multimodal feature analysis.
items.summary: This study validated a multimodal approach combining markerless motion capture and sEMG to quantitatively assess shoulder motor compensation in 25 stroke patients. Kinematic (Maximum Joint Angle, ρ=0.932, p<0.001) and electromyographic (Median Frequency, ρ=0.806, p<0.001) features showed strong correlations with traditional clinical scales, effectively distinguishing different motor recovery stages.
items.curatedReason: 对于卒中患者肩关节代偿的评估，你现在有了除传统临床量表外的一种新选择。这项包含 25 名患者的研究提示，无标记动作捕捉和表面肌电图结合的方法，在运动学（ρ=0.932）和肌电图（ρ=0.806）指标上，与现有量表高度相关，并能区分不同恢复阶段。未来，你或许可以考虑用这种客观方法来辅助优化康复方案。
items.titleZh: 基于多模态特征分析的卒中患者肩关节运动代偿定量评估
items.summaryZh: 本研究通过结合无标记动作捕捉和表面肌电图，对 25 名卒中患者的肩关节运动代偿进行了定量评估。运动学特征（最大关节角度，ρ=0.932，p<0.001）和肌电图特征（中位频率，ρ=0.806，p<0.001）与传统临床量表显示出强相关性，有效区分了不同运动恢复阶段。
items.curatedReasonEn: You now have a potential new option for assessing shoulder compensation in stroke patients beyond traditional clinical scales. This 25-patient study suggests that combining markerless motion capture and sEMG yields kinematic (ρ=0.932) and electromyographic (ρ=0.806) metrics highly correlated with existing scales, and can differentiate recovery stages. In the future, you might consider using this objective approach to help optimize rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（n=25），且仅关注了肩关节外展这一单一任务，可能限制了结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (n=25) and focuses on a single task (shoulder abduction), which may limit the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: Journal of electromyography and kinesiology : official journal of the International Society of Electrophysiological Kinesiology

items.title: Adaptive Sports Introduction During Inpatient Rehabilitation: A Descriptive Study.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 100 inpatients with new disabilities (stroke, SCI, amputation) found 43% desired exposure to adaptive sports during rehabilitation. Younger age (P<0.01) and pre-admission sports participation (P<0.05) correlated positively with this desire.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了急性康复阶段的新发残疾患者对适应性运动的强烈兴趣，特别是年轻患者和入院前有运动史的患者。这提示在院内早期介绍适应性运动对患者未来参与有积极影响。
items.titleZh: 住院康复期间适应性运动介绍：一项描述性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 100 名新发残疾住院患者（卒中、脊髓损伤、截肢）的横断面研究发现，43% 的患者希望在康复期间接触适应性运动。年轻（P<0.01）和入院前有运动史（P<0.05）与此愿望呈正相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals significant interest in adaptive sports among patients with new disabilities during acute rehabilitation, especially younger patients and those with a history of pre-admission sports participation. This suggests that early introduction of adaptive sports during inpatient stays positively influences future participation.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面描述性研究，无法建立因果关系，且基于自我报告的问卷调查可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional descriptive study cannot establish causality, and self-reported survey data may be subject to recall bias.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Study Protocol for a Randomized Controlled Trial Comparing Swiss Ball Balance Training and Conventional Balance Training to Improve Trunk Control and Mobility in Individuals with Sub acute Stroke.
items.summary: This study protocol outlines a randomized, assessor-blinded, two-period, two-sequence crossover trial to compare Swiss ball balance training and conventional balance training in subacute stroke patients over six weeks. The trial aims to assess improvements in trunk control, balance, and mobility, with expected greater gains from Swiss ball exercises.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究是 RCT 方案，而非最终结果，所以现在还不需要改变你的临床实践。如果未来研究证实瑞士球训练对亚急性卒中患者在躯干控制、平衡和活动能力上有优势，尤其是在资源有限的情况下，那么你将多一个可考虑的干预方案。在此之前，我们仍需等待其真实数据。
items.titleZh: 比较瑞士球平衡训练与常规平衡训练对亚急性卒中患者躯干控制和活动能力改善效果的随机对照试验方案
items.summaryZh: 本研究方案描述了一项随机、评估者盲法、两周期、两序列交叉试验，旨在比较瑞士球平衡训练与常规平衡训练对亚急性卒中患者的影响，干预期为六周。该试验旨在评估躯干控制、平衡和活动能力的改善，预计瑞士球训练会带来更大的获益。
items.curatedReasonEn: This is an RCT protocol, not final results, so no immediate change to your clinical practice is needed. Should future findings confirm superior gains in trunk control, balance, and mobility for subacute stroke patients using Swiss ball training, especially in resource-limited settings, you'll have an additional intervention option to consider. Until then, we await the actual data.
items.limitation: 本研究方案尚未执行，为一项试验方案，最终结果和临床有效性仍待验证。
items.limitationEn: This study is a protocol that has not yet been executed; the final results and clinical effectiveness are still pending validation.

items.title: Effects of neuromuscular electrical stimulation combined with blood flow restriction training on lower-leg neuromuscular function in individuals with chronic ankle instability: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: This randomized controlled trial (N=60) found that neuromuscular electrical stimulation combined with blood flow restriction training, when added to an 8-week exercise program for chronic ankle instability, yielded higher FAAM-Sports scores than exercise alone and NMES alone, but not BFRT alone. The combined intervention also showed broader favorable changes in secondary outcomes, particularly peroneus longus activation and eversion strength, though not consistently across all outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性踝关节不稳患者，在标准化运动方案中联合使用神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）和血流限制训练（BFRT），比单独运动或单一模式可能带来更广泛的短期益处，尤其是在腓骨长肌激活和外翻力量方面。但也要注意，这种联合干预并非在所有结果上都表现出一致优势。
items.titleZh: 神经肌肉电刺激联合血流限制训练对慢性踝关节不稳患者小腿神经肌肉功能的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项随机对照试验（N=60）发现，对于慢性踝关节不稳患者，在8周运动方案中加入神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）联合血流限制训练（BFRT），能比单独运动或单独NMES带来更高的FAAM-Sports评分，但与单独BFRT无显著差异。联合干预在腓骨长肌激活和外翻力量等次要结局指标上也显示出更广泛的有利变化，但并非在所有结果上都保持一致。
items.curatedReasonEn: For individuals with chronic ankle instability, combining neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) and blood flow restriction training (BFRT) with a standardized exercise program may offer broader short-term benefits than exercise alone or isolated modalities, especially in peroneus longus activation and eversion strength. However, this combined intervention does not show consistent advantages across all outcomes.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（N=60），随访期短（8周），且是单中心研究，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (N=60) and a short follow-up period (8 weeks), and is a single-center study, limiting generalizability.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Rotational perturbation training improves muscle coordination during reactive standing balance in trained and untrained conditions in children with spastic cerebral palsy.
items.summary: This longitudinal intervention study (N=14 children with CP, N=10 typically developing children) found that rotational perturbation training improved reactive standing balance and decreased muscle co-activation in children with spastic cerebral palsy. The training-induced adaptations generalized to untrained translational perturbations, suggesting modifiable balance control through perturbation training.
items.curatedReason: 这项干预研究发现，旋转扰动训练能有效改善痉挛性脑瘫儿童的反应性站立平衡能力和肌肉协调性，并且这种改善可以泛化到未经训练的扰动条件。这意味着你可以在儿童脑瘫的平衡训练中，考虑引入多样化的扰动训练，以促进更广泛的功能性适应。
items.titleZh: 旋转扰动训练改善痉挛性脑瘫儿童在训练和非训练条件下的反应性站立平衡肌肉协调性
items.summaryZh: 这项纵向干预研究（N=14名痉挛性脑瘫儿童，N=10名正常发育儿童）发现，旋转扰动训练改善了痉挛性脑瘫儿童的反应性站立平衡能力并降低了肌肉共同激活。训练引起的适应性泛化到未经训练的平移扰动，提示通过扰动训练可以改变平衡控制。
items.curatedReasonEn: This intervention study found that rotational perturbation training effectively improves reactive standing balance and muscle coordination in children with spastic cerebral palsy, and this improvement generalizes to untrained perturbation conditions. This suggests you can consider incorporating diverse perturbation training into balance interventions for children with cerebral palsy to promote broader functional adaptations.
items.limitation: 这是一个纵向干预研究，而非随机对照试验，且样本量较小（脑瘫儿童N=14，TD儿童N=10），缺乏对照组比较，结果存在偏倚风险。
items.limitationEn: This is a longitudinal intervention study, not a randomized controlled trial, with a small sample size (N=14 for CP children, N=10 for TD children), and lacks a control group comparison, posing a risk of bias.

items.title: Recent clinical practice guidelines for the management of low back pain: a global comparison
items.summary: This review identified 22 recent clinical practice guidelines (CPGs) for low back pain (LBP) from 2017 to 2022. It found significant heterogeneity in recommendations across guidelines, particularly for different stages of LBP, though common recommendations for acute, subacute, and chronic LBP included therapeutic exercise, NSAIDs, and spinal manipulation.
items.curatedReason: 对全球最新的22项腰痛临床实践指南的比较显示，不同指南在干预推荐上存在显著异质性。这意味着在处理腰痛时，你不能盲目照搬某一指南，而应批判性地审视其证据基础，并结合患者具体情况和执业环境灵活应用。
items.titleZh: 近期下腰痛管理临床实践指南：一项全球比较
items.summaryZh: 这项综述确定了2017年至2022年间的22份近期下腰痛（LBP）临床实践指南。研究发现，不同指南在推荐方面存在显著异质性，尤其针对LBP的不同阶段，但急性和慢性LBP的常见推荐包括治疗性运动、非甾体抗炎药和脊柱手法治疗。
items.curatedReasonEn: A comparison of 22 recent global LBP clinical practice guidelines reveals significant heterogeneity in recommended interventions. This means you shouldn't blindly follow a single guideline; instead, critically evaluate its evidence base and apply it flexibly, considering your patient's specific circumstances and practice environment.
items.limitation: 本综述仅分析了22份指南，且评估工具 AGREE II 仅能评估方法学质量，不能直接评价推荐的临床有效性。
items.limitationEn: This review only analyzed 22 guidelines, and the AGREE II tool only assesses methodological quality, not the clinical effectiveness of the recommendations.

items.title: Educational Videos Were Not Superior to a Folder in Improving Urinary Incontinence Knowledge and Symptoms: A Randomized Controlled Trial
items.summary: This single-blinded, parallel-group RCT (N=75) found that a remote health education program combining WhatsApp-delivered educational videos and an educational folder was not superior to the folder alone in improving urinary incontinence knowledge (95% CI −1.38 to 0.52), symptoms (95% CI −2.20 to 1.83), or severity (95% CI −1.37; 0.89) in incontinent women with high baseline knowledge.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 表明，对于已知盆底肌训练（PFMT）和尿失禁知识的患者，额外通过 WhatsApp 发送教育视频，在改善尿失禁知识、症状或严重程度上，并不优于单独的纸质教育手册。这意味着在已经提供了基础信息和盆底训练指导后，单纯增加视频形式的远程宣教可能效益有限，你应将资源用于更有效的干预手段。
items.titleZh: 教育视频在改善尿失禁知识和症状方面不优于纸质手册：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项单盲平行组随机对照试验（N=75）发现，对于基线知识水平较高的尿失禁女性，结合WhatsApp教育视频和纸质手册的远程健康教育项目，在改善尿失禁知识（95% CI −1.38 to 0.52）、症状（95% CI −2.20 to 1.83）或严重程度（95% CI −1.37; 0.89）方面，并不比单独使用纸质手册更优。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT indicates that for patients already familiar with pelvic floor muscle training (PFMT) and urinary incontinence (UI) knowledge, additional educational videos via WhatsApp did not show superior effectiveness in improving UI knowledge, symptoms, or severity compared to a paper-based educational folder alone. This suggests that simply adding video-based remote education might have limited benefits once basic information and PFMT guidance are provided, prompting you to allocate resources to more impactful interventions.
items.limitation: 研究对象为已知有高水平尿失禁相关知识且基线已患中度尿失禁的女性，结果不一定能外推至其他知识水平或疾病严重程度的患者。
items.limitationEn: The study participants were women with high baseline knowledge of urinary incontinence and moderate UI severity, so the results may not be generalizable to patients with different knowledge levels or disease severity.

items.title: Therapists’ perspectives on the use of an overground lower-limb exoskeleton in physiotherapy sessions for minimally ambulatory children with cerebral palsy: a qualitative study
items.summary: This qualitative descriptive study explored the perspectives of 5 physical therapists and 4 physical therapy assistants on using an overground lower-limb exoskeleton in physiotherapy sessions with 10 minimally ambulatory children (GMFCS Level IV, 4-6 years) with cerebral palsy. Therapists perceived exoskeletons as a valuable adjunct to conventional therapy, enhancing exercise options, inclusion, and autonomy, but identified new clinical skills, added resources, and individualized goal-based thinking as implementation challenges.
items.curatedReason: 下肢外骨骼被治疗师视为辅助脑瘫儿童康复的有用工具，能增加锻炼选择并提升参与度，但请注意，这只是对传统治疗的补充，而非替代。实施时，你需要考虑额外的人力、技能培训和资源投入，并牢记需以儿童的个体目标为导向。
items.titleZh: 治疗师对在物理治疗中使用下肢外骨骼辅助低活动度脑瘫儿童的看法：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 这项定性描述性研究探讨了5名物理治疗师和4名物理治疗助理在使用下肢外骨骼辅助10名低活动度（GMFCS IV级，4-6岁）脑瘫儿童进行物理治疗时的看法。治疗师认为外骨骼是传统疗法的有益补充，可增加运动选择、包容性和自主性，但也指出实施中面临新临床技能、额外资源和个性化目标导向思维等挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: Lower-limb exoskeletons are viewed by therapists as a valuable adjunct for pediatric cerebral palsy rehabilitation, enhancing exercise options and participation. However, remember they supplement, not replace, traditional therapy. Implementation requires considering additional staffing, skill training, and resources, always prioritizing individualized, goal-based thinking for the child.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，样本量小（N=5名PT，N=4名PTA），结果基于治疗师的感知，不提供量化的临床效果，且未经过同行评审。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (N=5 PTs, N=4 PTAs). The results are based on therapist perceptions and do not provide quantified clinical outcomes, and the preprint has not been certified by peer review.

items.title: Evidence-Based Insights for the Development and Talent Promotion of Young Athletes in a National Sports Context
items.summary: This perspective article examines the challenges and opportunities in integrating early talent promotion with sustainable athlete development frameworks, using the Swedish context as a case study. It argues for nuanced, evidence-based youth sport systems that support both elite performance and broader participation goals, emphasizing athlete well-being and intrinsic motivation.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评强调了青年运动员早期人才选拔与长期可持续发展之间的微妙平衡。作为康复治疗师，它提示我们应倡导建立一个更注重运动员整体福祉和内在动力的系统，但请注意，这更多是宏观政策层面的讨论，对你的日常临床决策没有直接指导意义。
items.titleZh: 国家体育背景下青年运动员发展与人才培养的循证见解
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评文章以瑞典为例，探讨了早期人才培养与可持续运动员发展框架相结合的挑战和机遇。文章主张采用细致入微的循证青年体育体系，同时支持精英表现和更广泛的参与目标，并强调运动员福祉和内在动力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary highlights the delicate balance between early talent identification and sustainable long-term development in youth athletes. As a rehab therapist, it prompts us to advocate for systems prioritizing athlete well-being and intrinsic motivation. However, note that this is a macro-level policy discussion with limited direct guidance for your daily clinical decisions.

items.title: Effects of flywheel training on post-activation performance enhancement in male basketball players
items.summary: This exploratory crossover study (N=20) investigated the acute effects of flywheel half-squat conditioning on post-activation performance enhancement (PAPE) in collegiate male basketball players using different inertias (low, moderate, high). It found small, task-, inertia-, and time-specific responses, with low inertia showing a favorable CMJ response at 12 min (+1.88%, 95% CI 0.54 to 3.21) and high inertia showing a favorable SJ response at 12 min (+3.74%, 95% CI 1.34 to 6.15).
items.curatedReason: 飞轮半蹲训练确实能在篮球运动员中引起PAPE效应，但记住这效应是小幅、任务、惯性和时间特异性的。如果你想将其应用于赛前激活，不妨尝试低惯性负荷以改善CMJ，或高惯性负荷以改善SJ，并在12分钟左右进行测试，但效果可能因人而异。
items.titleZh: 飞轮训练对男性篮球运动员激活后表现增强的影响
items.summaryZh: 这项探索性交叉研究（N=20）调查了飞轮半深蹲训练在不同惯性负荷（低、中、高）下对大学男性篮球运动员激活后表现增强（PAPE）的急性影响。研究发现，表现提升效应是小幅度的、任务特异的、惯性特异的、时间特异的，其中低惯性负荷在12分钟时对 CMJ 表现有利（+1.88%，95% CI 0.54 to 3.21），高惯性负荷在12分钟时对 SJ 表现有利（+3.74%，95% CI 1.34 to 6.15）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Flywheel half-squat conditioning can induce PAPE in basketball players, but remember this effect is small, task-, inertia-, and time-specific. If you want to apply it for pre-game activation, consider low inertia for CMJ improvement or high inertia for SJ improvement, testing around 12 minutes, but outcomes may vary individually.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（N=20），仅限于大学生男性篮球运动员，且研究评估的急性效应持续时间较短，长期训练效果尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (N=20) and is limited to collegiate male basketball players. The assessed acute effects are short-lived, and long-term training efficacy remains unclear.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Physical Exercise Reduces Fall-Related Outcomes Among People With Stroke: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 18 RCTs (1536 participants) found that physical exercise significantly reduced the number of falls by 39% (IRR = 0.61, 95% CI = [0.47, 0.78]) in people with stroke, with balance and cognitively integrated training being most effective, especially for those in the chronic stage with mild-moderate disability.
items.curatedReason: 跌倒预防是卒中康复的重中之重，这项高质量系统综述（18项RCT）明确指出，物理运动可将卒中患者的跌倒风险降低39%。特别是针对慢性期、中度残疾的患者，平衡与认知相结合的训练是你的首选干预，务必将其纳入治疗计划。
items.titleZh: 体育锻炼可减少卒中患者跌倒相关结局：一项系统综述和荟萃分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项包含18项随机对照试验（1536名参与者）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，体育锻炼显著减少了卒中患者跌倒次数达39%（IRR = 0.61, 95% CI = [0.47, 0.78]）。其中，平衡训练和认知整合的训练效果最佳，特别适用于卒中慢性期、轻中度残疾的患者。
items.curatedReasonEn: Fall prevention is paramount in stroke rehabilitation. This high-quality systematic review (18 RCTs) unequivocally shows physical exercise reduces falls by 39% in stroke patients. For those in the chronic stage with mild-moderate disability, prioritize balance and cognitively integrated training; it must be a core part of your intervention.
items.limitation: 虽然运动减少了跌倒次数，但对受伤性跌倒和跌倒者的影响不那么显著，提示还需要进一步研究如何降低跌倒的严重程度。
items.limitationEn: While exercise reduced the number of falls, its effect on injurious falls and fallers was less apparent, suggesting further research is needed on mitigating fall severity.

items.title: Leader and Follower Roles in Adapted Tango Reveal Complementary Neural Routes to Motor Improvement in Parkinson's Disease
items.summary: An RCT randomized people with mild-to-moderate Parkinson's Disease (PD) to 12 weeks of adapted tango as Leaders, Followers, or a Control. Both dance groups showed significant clinical improvement, including reduced overall disease severity and motor impairment, with Leaders showing network stability and Followers increased sensorimotor/caudate-motor connectivity, suggesting complementary neural routes to motor improvement.
items.curatedReason: 帕金森病患者参与改编探戈舞蹈，无论是作为主导者（Leader）还是追随者（Follower），都能改善运动功能和疾病整体严重程度。这种双重机制提示，在设计康复干预时，可以同时考虑内部生成（Leader）和外部引导（Follower）的运动策略。
items.titleZh: 改编探戈中主导者和追随者的角色揭示帕金森病运动改善的互补神经通路
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验将轻中度帕金森病（PD）患者随机分配至12周的改编探戈主导者组、追随者组或对照组。结果显示，两个舞蹈组均表现出显著的临床改善，包括总体疾病严重程度和运动障碍的减轻。主导者组表现出网络稳定性，追随者组则显示感觉运动/尾状核-运动连接性增加，这提示运动改善存在互补的神经通路。
items.curatedReasonEn: Adapted tango, whether as a Leader or Follower, improves motor function and overall disease severity in Parkinson's disease. This dual mechanism suggests that both internally generated (Leader) and externally guided (Follower) movement strategies can be considered when designing rehabilitation interventions.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步研究（pilot study），样本量较小，神经连接性分析基于静息态功能连接，不直接反映任务态下的脑活动。
items.limitationEn: This is a pilot study with a small sample size, and neural connectivity analysis is based on resting-state functional connectivity, which does not directly reflect brain activity during task execution.

items.title: Association Between Therapeutic Education Delivered by a Community Post-Stroke Rehabilitation Team and Improvement in the Frenchay Activities Index: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study (n=163) found that home-based therapeutic patient education (TPE) delivered by a Community Stroke Rehabilitation Team was associated with greater improvement in social participation post-stroke (mean FAI change: 6.02 vs 1.62, p < 0.001), especially when combined with physical activity workshops.
items.curatedReason: 社区卒中康复团队提供的居家治疗性教育（特别是结合体育活动工作坊）与卒中后社会参与度的显著改善相关。在考虑卒中患者的社区康复方案时，请优先纳入教育和积极运动元素。
items.titleZh: 社区卒中康复团队提供的治疗性教育与法国生活活动指数（Frenchay Activities Index）改善的关联：一项回顾性队列研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究（n=163）发现，由社区卒中康复团队提供的居家治疗性患者教育（TPE）与卒中后社会参与度的显著改善相关（FAI平均变化：6.02 vs 1.62, p < 0.001），特别是当TPE结合了体育活动工作坊时。
items.curatedReasonEn: Home-based therapeutic education delivered by community stroke rehabilitation teams, especially when combined with physical activity workshops, is associated with significant improvements in social participation after stroke. Prioritize incorporating educational and active movement elements when planning community rehabilitation for stroke patients.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性队列研究，尽管调整了混杂因素，但其结论仍受观察性研究固有的局限性影响，不能确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: As a retrospective cohort study, its conclusions, despite adjustments for confounders, are subject to the inherent limitations of observational research and cannot establish causality.

items.title: Immediate and fatigue-related effects of subtalar sling taping in individuals with chronic ankle instability.
items.summary: An RCT (n=90) comparing rigid subtalar sling taping (RST), kinesio subtalar sling taping (KST), and sham taping in individuals with chronic ankle instability (CAI) found KST led to higher Y-Balance Test scores than sham taping post-fatigue and after recovery. RST and KST showed outcome-dependent effects, but no consistent superiority of one over the other was observed across all outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性踝关节不稳患者，肌内效贴和硬质贴扎在疲劳后都能在Y-平衡测试中改善表现，但效果因具体结局指标和时间点而异，没有一种方法能全面优于另一种。在临床实践中，可根据患者反应选择性使用。
items.titleZh: 副距骨吊带贴扎对慢性踝关节不稳患者的即时和疲劳相关影响。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=90）比较了硬质副距骨吊带贴扎（RST）、肌内效副距骨吊带贴扎（KST）和假贴扎对慢性踝关节不稳（CAI）患者的影响。研究发现，KST 在疲劳后和恢复期，Y-平衡测试分数高于假贴扎。RST 和 KST 表现出依赖于结局的效应，但在所有结局中未观察到任一方法具有持续的优越性。
items.curatedReasonEn: For individuals with chronic ankle instability, both kinesiology tape and rigid taping can improve performance on the Y-Balance Test after fatigue, but effects vary by outcome and time point, with no consistent superiority of one over the other. Use these selectively based on patient response in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 研究观察到的一些差异虽然具有统计学意义，但其临床重要性需要进一步验证，且结果未在所有结局指标上保持一致。
items.limitationEn: Some observed differences, while statistically significant, require further validation for their clinical importance, and results were not consistent across all outcome measures.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Motor Module-Guided Human-Machine Interaction Promotes Improvement of Neuromuscular Coordination and Reduction in Motor Impairment in Chronic Stroke: A Pilot Study
items.summary: A pilot study with five chronic stroke survivors in the motor module-guided intervention and three in a force-guided control group found that the motor module-guided human-machine interaction intervention improved neuromuscular coordination and led to clinically meaningful, sustained reductions in upper extremity motor impairment, which correlated with enhanced stroke-induced motor module composition.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究提示，肌模块引导的人机交互康复能有效改善慢性卒中患者的神经肌肉协调性，从而减轻运动障碍，且效果可保持。这为治疗卒中后上肢功能障碍提供了一个新的有前景的方向。
items.titleZh: 运动模块引导的人机交互促进慢性卒中患者神经肌肉协调性改善和运动障碍减轻：一项初步研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对5名慢性卒中幸存者进行运动模块引导干预、3名幸存者进行力量引导对照的初步研究发现，运动模块引导的人机交互干预改善了神经肌肉协调性，并导致上肢运动障碍的临床有意义且持续的减轻，这与卒中引起的运动模块组成增强相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study suggests that motor module-guided human-machine interaction rehabilitation effectively improves neuromuscular coordination in chronic stroke survivors, reducing motor impairment with sustained effects. This offers a promising new direction for treating post-stroke upper extremity dysfunction.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本的初步研究（pilot study），虽然结果有希望，但仍需更大规模的随机对照试验来验证其有效性和机制。
items.limitationEn: This is a pilot study with a small sample size. While the results are promising, larger randomized controlled trials are needed to validate its efficacy and mechanisms.

items.title: Adding the short, digital PainSMART-educational strategy whilst patients with musculoskeletal pain wait for primary care physiotherapy: A randomised controlled trial.
items.summary: A multi-centre RCT (n=504) found that adding a 7-minute pain science education film (PainSMART) to usual physiotherapy for musculoskeletal pain did not result in additional clinically meaningful benefits once physiotherapy commenced, though it may facilitate earlier improvements in self-efficacy and perceptions during waiting times.
items.curatedReason: 疼痛科学教育的短期数字策略（PainSMART）在患者等待初级理疗期间，能改善疼痛自我效能和疼痛认知，但不带来长期临床益处，不应替代常规物理治疗。
items.titleZh: 在肌肉骨骼疼痛患者等待初级理疗期间，附加短期数字疼痛教育策略（PainSMART）：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心随机对照试验（n=504）发现，对于肌肉骨骼疼痛患者，在常规理疗之外增加一个7分钟的疼痛科学教育视频（PainSMART）后，一旦理疗开始，并未带来额外的临床有意义的益处。但在等待期，它可能有助于患者提前改善疼痛自我效能和疼痛认知。
items.curatedReasonEn: The PainSMART digital pain science education strategy, while improving pain self-efficacy and perceptions in the short term while patients await physiotherapy, does not offer additional clinically meaningful long-term benefits once physiotherapy begins. Do not use it as a substitute for standard physiotherapy.
items.limitation: 本研究的疼痛自我效能在随访1（治疗前）有统计学差异，但在主要分析时间点（治疗后）差异不显著，提示其效果可能短暂且主要发生在等待期。
items.limitationEn: The statistically significant difference in pain self-efficacy was observed only at follow-up 1 (pre-physiotherapy consultation), but not at the primary analysis time points (post-consultation), suggesting its effect may be transient and primarily during the waiting period.

items.title: If ACL injury is multifactorial, why is return-to-sport testing not? A determinant-alignment framework for ACL rehabilitation and return to sport.
items.summary: This Masterclass proposes a determinant-alignment framework for ACL rehabilitation and return-to-sport (RTS) assessment, emphasizing that RTS testing should be as multifactorial as ACL injury itself, integrating physical capacity with perceptual, neurocognitive, and sport-contextual demands beyond traditional strength and hop tests.
items.curatedReason: ACL 损伤是一个多因素问题，这意味着你的重返运动评估也必须超越简单的体能测试，整合神经认知、感知、运动情境等更广泛的要素。使用这份框架来识别你评估中的潜在盲区。
items.titleZh: 如果 ACL 损伤是多因素的，为什么重返运动测试不是？一个 ACL 康复和重返运动的决定因素对齐框架。
items.summaryZh: 本篇大师班文章提出了一个针对 ACL 康复和重返运动（RTS）评估的决定因素对齐框架，强调 RTS 测试应像 ACL 损伤本身一样具有多因素性，将体能与感知、神经认知和运动情境需求整合，超越传统的肌力与跳跃测试。
items.curatedReasonEn: ACL injury is multifactorial, which means your return-to-sport assessment must extend beyond simple physical capacity tests to integrate broader neurocognitive, perceptual, and sport-contextual elements. Use this framework to identify potential blind spots in your assessments.
items.limitation: 该框架是一个假设生成性的临床启发式模型，并非经过验证的分类法或预测算法，其价值在于引导思考而非提供直接的临床决策依据。
items.limitationEn: This framework is a hypothesis-generating clinical heuristic, not a validated taxonomy or prediction algorithm, intended to guide thinking rather than provide direct clinical decision support.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Autonomic responses to repeated locomotor perturbations in older adults: dissociation between phasic habituation and sustained tonic arousal.
items.summary: In 18 older adults, repeated slip perturbations during walking elicited a significant phasic increase in sympathetic nervous system (SNS) activity (%SCR) that habituated with repetition but restored with a change in perturbation direction. Tonic SNS activity (%SCL) remained elevated, suggesting sustained vigilance, supporting the potential benefit of perturbation-based balance training.
items.curatedReason: 老年人在行走时经历平衡扰动会触发交感神经系统反应，并迅速习惯于重复的、相同方向的扰动，但新方向的扰动会重新激发反应。这意味着基于扰动的平衡训练是有效的，但需多样化以维持警觉性。
items.titleZh: 老年人对重复步态扰动的自主神经反应：相位性适应与持续性张力性觉醒的分离。
items.summaryZh: 在18名老年人中，行走时重复的滑倒扰动会引起交感神经系统（SNS）活动的显著相位性增加（%SCR），这种反应随着重复而适应，但在扰动方向改变时又会恢复。张力性SNS活动（%SCL）持续升高，表明持续警觉，这支持了基于扰动的平衡训练的潜在益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: Older adults exhibit sympathetic nervous system responses to balance perturbations during walking, rapidly habituating to repeated, same-direction perturbations, but showing renewed responses to novel perturbation directions. This suggests that perturbation-based balance training is effective but requires diversification to maintain vigilance.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（n=18），且仅限于健康老年人，结果在外推至有平衡障碍或不同病理特征的老年人群时需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (n=18) and was limited to healthy older adults, so results should be interpreted cautiously when extrapolating to older populations with balance impairments or different pathologies.
items.journal: Journal of electromyography and kinesiology : official journal of the International Society of Electrophysiological Kinesiology

items.title: Implementation of group-based health education and exercise for individuals with knee osteoarthritis in brazilian primary health care: a mixed-methods study.
items.summary: A mixed-methods implementation study found a physical therapist-led, group-based exercise and education program for knee osteoarthritis was feasible and well-accepted in Brazilian primary health care, with high recruitment (87.3%) and retention (83%), and exploratory clinical outcomes suggesting improvements.
items.curatedReason: 这项巴西的研究表明，物理治疗师主导的、基于团体的骨关节炎运动与健康教育项目在基层医疗中可行且广受欢迎。这支持将同类循证方案整合到常规护理中，尤其是在资源受限的环境。
items.titleZh: 巴西基层医疗中针对膝骨关节炎患者的团体健康教育和运动实施：一项混合方法研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项混合方法实施研究显示，在巴西基层医疗中，由物理治疗师主导的膝骨关节炎团体运动和健康教育项目是可行且广受欢迎的，招募率（87.3%）和依从性（83%）均高，探索性临床结局提示患者症状有所改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Brazilian study demonstrates the feasibility and high acceptance of a physical therapist-led, group-based exercise and health education program for knee osteoarthritis in primary care. This supports integrating similar evidence-based programs into routine care, especially in resource-constrained settings.
items.limitation: 这是一项混合方法实施研究，探索性临床结局提示了改善，但并非以临床疗效为主要目标。
items.limitationEn: This was a mixed-methods implementation study, and while exploratory clinical outcomes suggested improvements, it was not primarily designed to evaluate clinical efficacy.

items.title: Effects of Virtual Reality-Assisted Task-Oriented Training on Clinical and Psychosocial Outcomes in Individuals with Rotator Cuff Tears: A Randomized Controlled Single-Blind Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=60) found adding virtual reality-assisted task-oriented training to conventional physiotherapy significantly improved DASH scores, pain, shoulder disability, kinesiophobia, and pain catastrophizing in individuals with rotator cuff tears, with a mean between-group DASH difference of -3.93 points (95% CI, -4.79 to -3.08; p<0.001), though the difference did not reach MCID.
items.curatedReason: 虚拟现实辅助的任务导向训练（VR-TOT）结合常规物理治疗，可显著改善肩袖撕裂患者的上肢功能和疼痛相关心理状况。将 VR-TOT 作为辅助手段，有助于提升患者体验和短期结局，但长期疗效尚待更多研究。
items.titleZh: 虚拟现实辅助任务导向训练对肩袖撕裂患者临床及社会心理结局的影响：一项随机对照单盲试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=60）发现，在常规物理治疗中加入虚拟现实辅助任务导向训练，能显著改善肩袖撕裂患者的 DASH 评分、疼痛、肩部残疾、运动恐惧症和疼痛灾难化，组间 DASH 差异为 -3.93 分 (95% CI, -4.79 to -3.08; p<0.001)，但未达到最小临床重要差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Virtual reality-assisted task-oriented training (VR-TOT) combined with conventional physiotherapy significantly improved upper extremity function and pain-related psychological status in individuals with rotator cuff tears. Incorporating VR-TOT as an adjunct can enhance patient experience and short-term outcomes, though long-term efficacy warrants further investigation.
items.limitation: 研究的 DASH 改善幅度未达到已公布的最小临床重要差异 (MCID)，且随访时间较短，需要长期研究来评估持久效果。
items.limitationEn: The improvement in DASH score did not reach the published Minimally Clinically Important Difference (MCID), and the study duration was short, requiring longer-term studies to assess sustained effects.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Scar dry needling for tissue compliance in individuals with linear scars: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=80) found scar dry needling (DN) was associated with greater tissue compliance at 5mm and 10mm indentation depths immediately post-treatment and at 10mm depth at follow-up compared to minimal needling, with adjusted mean differences ranging from -4.51 N to -9.84 N, but no significant differences in pain or quality of life.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机对照试验表明，疤痕干针可短期改善线性疤痕的组织柔韧性，尤其是在 5 毫米和 10 毫米压痕深度。这支持干针作为疤痕管理的辅助手段，但其长期效果、对疼痛或生活质量的影响仍需更多证据。
items.titleZh: 线性疤痕患者疤痕干针改善组织柔韧性：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=80）发现，与最小针刺相比，疤痕干针（DN）在治疗后立即和随访时，在 5 毫米和 10 毫米压痕深度下均与更高的组织柔韧性相关，调整后的平均差异范围为 -4.51 N 至 -9.84 N，但在疼痛或生活质量方面无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized controlled trial suggests that scar dry needling can temporarily improve tissue compliance in linear scars, particularly at 5 mm and 10 mm indentation depths. This supports dry needling as an adjunct for scar management, but its long-term effects on pain or quality of life require more evidence.
items.limitation: 研究中疼痛分析的样本量不足，且疤痕干针的临床重要性和效果持久性仍不确定。
items.limitationEn: The pain analysis in the study was underpowered, and the clinical importance and durability of scar dry needling effects remain uncertain.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: Centering First Nations parents' voices: a community-directed pediatric rehabilitation needs assessment in Northern Saskatchewan.
items.summary: A community-directed qualitative study in Northern Saskatchewan explored First Nations parents' experiences (n=14) with pediatric rehabilitation, revealing systemic barriers, unmet needs, and a call for strength-based, family-centered, culturally grounded, and community-led services, with hybrid care showing promise.
items.curatedReason: 在原住民儿童康复领域，这份加拿大研究揭示了系统性障碍和未满足的需求，强调必须构建以优势为基础、家庭为中心、文化为根基、社区主导的服务模式。这提醒我们在提供跨文化康复服务时，必须深入理解并尊重服务对象的文化背景和需求，混合式照护模式或可考虑。
items.titleZh: 以原住民父母的声音为中心：北萨斯喀彻温省一项社区指导的儿童康复需求评估。
items.summaryZh: 一项在北萨斯喀彻温省开展的社区指导定性研究，探讨了原住民父母（n=14）在儿童康复方面的经验，揭示了系统性障碍和未满足的需求，并呼吁提供以优势为本、以家庭为中心、以文化为基础和以社区为主导的服务，其中混合护理模式显示出前景。
items.curatedReasonEn: In pediatric rehabilitation for First Nations children, this Canadian study reveals systemic barriers and unmet needs, emphasizing the imperative for strength-based, family-centered, culturally grounded, and community-led service models. This reminds us that when delivering cross-cultural rehabilitation services, we must deeply understand and respect the cultural context and needs of those we serve; hybrid care models may offer promise.
items.limitation: 作为定性研究，其结果来源于特定社区的有限样本，可能难以直接推广到所有原住民群体或其他文化背景。
items.limitationEn: As a qualitative study, its findings are derived from a limited sample within a specific community, which may not be directly generalizable to all Indigenous populations or other cultural contexts.

items.title: Is therapeutic exercise as a standalone intervention effective in reducing kinesiophobia in adults with nonspecific chronic low back pain? A systematic review and meta-analysis with meta-regression
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of eight RCTs (854 participants) found that standalone therapeutic exercise significantly reduced kinesiophobia in adults with nonspecific chronic low back pain compared to passive controls and usual care (MD = −5.38; 95% CI −7.63 to −3.13; SMD = −1.03), exceeding the minimal clinically important difference, despite low certainty of evidence and high heterogeneity.
items.curatedReason: 独立运动疗法在非特异性慢性腰痛患者中，显著降低了运动恐惧（MD = −5.38），且效应量超过了最小临床重要差异，提示其作为一线干预对心理社会因素的积极作用。尽管证据质量仍有待提高且异质性高，但你可以考虑将运动疗法作为干预运动恐惧的有效手段。
items.titleZh: 独立运动疗法对非特异性慢性腰痛患者运动恐惧的疗效：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入8项随机对照试验（854名参与者）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，与被动对照和常规护理相比，独立运动疗法显著减轻了非特异性慢性腰痛成人患者的运动恐惧（MD = −5.38；95% CI −7.63至−3.13；SMD = −1.03），超过了最小临床重要差异，尽管证据确定性较低且异质性较高。
items.curatedReasonEn: Standalone therapeutic exercise significantly reduced kinesiophobia (MD = −5.38) in adults with nonspecific chronic low back pain, with an effect size exceeding the minimal clinically important difference, suggesting a positive role for psychosocial factors. Despite low certainty and high heterogeneity, you can consider therapeutic exercise an effective intervention for kinesiophobia.
items.limitation: 证据确定性被评为低，且荟萃分析存在显著异质性（I² ≈ 94%），限制了对汇总效应估计的信心。
items.limitationEn: The certainty of evidence was rated as low, and substantial heterogeneity was observed (I² ≈ 94%), limiting confidence in the pooled effect estimate.
